content.comment_body: How many SMS messages can be sent using [product_name] [version_no] and [product_name] [product_name]? I have 24 digital inputs with [product_name], and I want to send both ON and OFF state SMS for each input, totaling 48 messages. Regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], I hope you are doing well! There is no official information in the manual about the maximum number of SMS messages you can send. From my own testing, sending more than 24 messages worked without issue. However, please note that rapid sending could cause delays. Best of luck achieving your goal! [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for information about the maximum number of SMS messages that can be sent using [product_name] [version_no] with [product_name].
